title: The Parables of the Kingdom
notes: This chunk delivers a dense, law-positive derivation of the sower parable with tight OT cross-references and a clean four-for-four grading table that asserts the closed-book method without apology. Strengths include the uniform-symbol principle, the Eden-to-heart ground chain, and the personal concession that modern tools enable independent work. Residual defects are presenter staging cues (Stop and weigh, Now derive) plus multiple author-prose sentences that open with And or That. A few instructional imperatives lean toward director register rather than pure assertion. Scripture quotes and symbol links are clean; no doctrine or factual mismatches appear.

This chunk is strong on tight OT-to-parable derivation for mustard, leaven, treasure, pearl, and net, with clear Teacher keys, law-positive stance, and effective inversion of the common treasure reading. The feeding similitude lands cleanly as lived symbol. Residual defects are concentrated: six author-prose sentences open with And or But, one stock AI term (landscapes), and presenter staging (Write the derivation out, Derive it, Mark them, Test it, mark what). Exam/grading register is deliberate and should remain. Surgical open and cue fixes restore house style without touching doctrine, quotes, or symbol claims.

This closing chunk delivers a dense, assertive tally of the parables exam and a strong density argument that fits the book's law-positive voice. Scripture linkage and the householder application land cleanly. Residual problems are three author-prose openings with And/That, two director-style 'mark' cues, one awkward presenter phrase ('watched graded'), and spelled-out counts that violate the digits house rule. Surgical fixes restore the rules without thinning the argument or touching doctrine.

proposals.old:
Stop and weigh that rebuke.
A teacher may not be astonished that students fail an exam on material they were never given; His astonishment is only just if the answers were already on the table.
proposals.new: A teacher may not be astonished that students fail an exam on material they were never given; His astonishment is only just if the answers were already on the table.
proposals.summary: Remove banned director cue.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids Stop and and Weigh the staging. The following sentence already carries the claim.

proposals.old: And the Scriptures the disciples grew up on do not merely contain parables — they decode them in front of the reader and expect him to grade himself.
proposals.new: The Scriptures the disciples grew up on do not merely contain parables — they decode them in front of the reader and expect him to grade himself.
proposals.summary: Drop leading And.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not open with And. The claim stands intact without it.

proposals.old: That is how this chapter will read them, and it will keep score.
proposals.new: This chapter will read them that way, and it will keep score.
proposals.summary: Rewrite to avoid leading That.
proposals.rationale: House style bars sentences that begin with That in author prose. Meaning and density are preserved.

proposals.old: Next, weigh what you gathered before you lean on it.
proposals.new: Next, examine what you gathered before you lean on it.
proposals.summary: Replace weigh staging verb.
proposals.rationale: Weigh the is listed as banned director language. Examine keeps the evaluative force without the cue.

proposals.old: That standard is what makes the rebuke in the boat just, and it measures its weight: Jesus did not upbraid the twelve for missing an obscurity; seed and ground and thorns and fowls were established patterns, laid down across the whole of the Scriptures read to them every sabbath since childhood.
proposals.new: This standard is what makes the rebuke in the boat just, and it measures its weight: Jesus did not upbraid the twelve for missing an obscurity; seed and ground and thorns and fowls were established patterns, laid down across the whole of the Scriptures read to them every sabbath since childhood.
proposals.summary: Change leading That to This.
proposals.rationale: Author prose cannot open with That. This preserves reference and assertion.

proposals.old: Now derive what the thorns *mean*, for the Old Testament assigns that too.
proposals.new: Derive what the thorns *mean*, for the Old Testament assigns that too.
proposals.summary: Drop banned Now derive cue.
proposals.rationale: House style explicitly forbids Now derive. The imperative remains assertive without the staging prefix.

proposals.old: And that pair of weeds — thorn and thistle together — returns exactly once more in the Hebrew Scriptures, and Hosea builds the whole indictment around it:
proposals.new: The pair of weeds — thorn and thistle together — returns exactly once more in the Hebrew Scriptures, and Hosea builds the whole indictment around it:
proposals.summary: Remove And and That openers.
proposals.rationale: Sentence cannot begin with And or That. The pair keeps the anaphoric force cleanly.

proposals.old: And why is the exchange a heart of *flesh* for a heart of *stone*?
proposals.new: Why is the exchange a heart of *flesh* for a heart of *stone*?
proposals.summary: Drop leading And.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not open with And. The rhetorical question stands stronger without it.

proposals.old: Write the derivation out: an enemy's seed grows beside God's seed in one field, indistinguishable until fruit, and a harvest-day of burning sorts them.
proposals.new: The derivation is plain: an enemy's seed grows beside God's seed in one field, indistinguishable until fruit, and a harvest-day of burning sorts them.
proposals.summary: Replace director command with direct assertion of the derivation.
proposals.rationale: Write the derivation out functions as a presenter cue. The rephrased line asserts the same content in the author's voice.

proposals.old: And the disciples had already watched God plant the least and grow it into the shelter of the world, in a parable He decoded Himself:
proposals.new: The disciples had already watched God plant the least and grow it into the shelter of the world, in a parable He decoded Himself:
proposals.summary: Remove leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that begin with And.

proposals.old: But carry the first parable's edge with you: fowls also devour seed, and Assyria's sheltering cedar housed __“all great nations”__ on its way to the axe (Ezekiel 31:6) — the branches that shelter the nations shelter what the nations bring.
proposals.new: The first parable's edge still applies: fowls also devour seed, and Assyria's sheltering cedar housed __“all great nations”__ on its way to the axe (Ezekiel 31:6) — the branches that shelter the nations shelter what the nations bring.
proposals.summary: Remove leading But and the carry-with-you cue.
proposals.rationale: Sentence opens with But; carry ... with you echoes forbidden keep-in-mind staging. The replacement asserts the same caution.

proposals.old: And the treasure has a definition older than the parable, spoken at Sinai to the whole nation:
proposals.new: The treasure has a definition older than the parable, spoken at Sinai to the whole nation:
proposals.summary: Remove leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that begin with And.

proposals.old: And this treasure is hidden — Asaph says so of the saints themselves: the enemy takes __“crafty counsel against thy people,”__ consulting __“against thy *hidden ones*”__ (Psalm 83:3).
proposals.new: This treasure is hidden — Asaph says so of the saints themselves: the enemy takes __“crafty counsel against thy people,”__ consulting __“against thy *hidden ones*”__ (Psalm 83:3).
proposals.summary: Remove leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that begin with And.

proposals.old: And the sym:sym-pearl[Pearl] chapter will carry the derivation a ring deeper, for the parable holds more than a jewel: the gates of the city John saw are waiting inside it, and Scripture keeps its one pearl of great price where no tradition has thought to look for it.
proposals.new: The sym:sym-pearl[Pearl] chapter will carry the derivation a ring deeper, for the parable holds more than a jewel: the gates of the city John saw are waiting inside it, and Scripture keeps its one pearl of great price where no tradition has thought to look for it.
proposals.summary: Remove leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that begin with And.

proposals.old: And the sorting on the shore was Torah before it was parable — fins and scales, clean from unclean (Leviticus 11:9-10): these men were fishermen of Israel; they had sorted every catch of their lives by Leviticus.
proposals.new: The sorting on the shore was Torah before it was parable — fins and scales, clean from unclean (Leviticus 11:9-10): these men were fishermen of Israel; they had sorted every catch of their lives by Leviticus.
proposals.summary: Remove leading And from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences that begin with And.

proposals.old: Two landscapes, one message — the sown sym:sym-field[field] and the peopled sea — because the kingdom is drawing from both.
proposals.new: Two pictures, one message — the sown sym:sym-field[field] and the peopled sea — because the kingdom is drawing from both.
proposals.summary: Replace banned AI term landscapes.
proposals.rationale: Landscape is listed stock AI vocabulary. Pictures preserves the parallel and the biblical image pair without the modern register slip.

proposals.old: And mark why the score was owed: not one answer hung on a single verse.
proposals.new: The score was owed for this reason: not one answer hung on a single verse.
proposals.summary: Remove And-start and director 'mark' cue.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not open with And; 'mark why' is a banned director cue. The replacement keeps the claim and colon structure.

proposals.old: Where He supplied none — the mustard tree, the leaven, the treasure, the pearl — the same Scriptures carry the reader most of the way, and mark plainly where the derivation ends and the testing begins.
proposals.new: Where He supplied none — the mustard tree, the leaven, the treasure, the pearl — the same Scriptures carry the reader most of the way, and show plainly where the derivation ends and the testing begins.
proposals.summary: Replace director 'mark plainly' with neutral verb.
proposals.rationale: 'Mark plainly' functions as a presenter cue to the reader. 'Show plainly' keeps the same claim with Scriptures as subject.

proposals.old: That is why His rebuke was fair, and why His question was not rhetorical.
proposals.new: His rebuke was fair for that reason, and His question was not rhetorical.
proposals.summary: Remove That-start from author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences opening with That. The rewrite preserves the causal link without the banned opener.

proposals.old: That is the reader this book aims to form: not a keeper of its conclusions but a scribe instructed — one who can take a text he has never been taught, derive it from what Scripture itself defined, mark honestly what remains under test, and go gather the uses.
proposals.new: This book aims to form that reader: not a keeper of its conclusions but a scribe instructed — one who can take a text he has never been taught, derive it from what Scripture itself defined, mark honestly what remains under test, and go gather the uses.
proposals.summary: Remove That-start while keeping the target description.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not open with That. The new lead keeps the identical definition of the intended reader.

proposals.old: The seven parables, with the householder's saying that seals them, run twenty-six verses — some five hundred and eighty-five words — and carry more than fifty decodable terms, one symbolic use every five words, defined by more than eighty passages from twenty-three books of the Law, the Prophets, and the Psalms.
proposals.new: The seven parables, with the householder's saying that seals them, run 26 verses — some 585 words — and carry more than 50 decodable terms, one symbolic use every 5 words, defined by more than 80 passages from 23 books of the Law, the Prophets, and the Psalms.
proposals.summary: Convert count numbers to digits per house style.
proposals.rationale: House style requires digits for counts. The change is purely orthographic and leaves every claim intact.

proposals.old: Everything that follows in this book stands or falls with the method you have just watched graded; once the method holds, the conclusions are arithmetic.
proposals.new: Everything that follows in this book stands or falls with the method just graded; once the method holds, the conclusions are arithmetic.
proposals.summary: Remove presenter staging and fix awkward 'watched graded'.
proposals.rationale: 'You have just watched' is director staging; 'watched graded' is also ungrammatical. 'Just graded' is assertive and clear.
